user.title: Connect to Control4
user.description: Use your Control4 account and local Director address. Credentials stay in Home Assistant's config entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Control4
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current Control4 account password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Control4 account service or Director
error.invalid_host: Enter an address without a scheme, port, or path
error.no_devices: No supported lights or thermostats were found

menu_option_descriptions.retrieve_tidal: Capture your TIDAL playlists while you open them in the Control4 app.
menu_option_descriptions.retrieve_tunein: Capture your TuneIn favorites while you open them in the Control4 app.
menu_option_descriptions.media_favorites: TIDAL accounts and TuneIn sources are discovered automatically. Configure optional TIDAL playlists and TuneIn favorites.
menu_option_descriptions.recreate_entity_ids: Apply Home Assistant's current automatic naming format to every entity in this Control4 integration entry.

media_favorites.title: Control4 options
media_favorites.description: TIDAL accounts and TuneIn sources are discovered automatically. Director does not expose their dynamic playlist/favorite lists to this integration, so optional playable items use: TIDAL source name | playlist name | playlist UUID; TuneIn source name | favorite name | Station/id. Entries appear only in rooms where that source is available.

recreate_entity_ids.title: Recreate all Control4 entity IDs?

progress.retrieve_tidal: Listening for TIDAL playlists from: {sources}. Now open the Control4 app, choose Listen, open each named TIDAL account, then go directly to My Collection/Library > Playlists Created by Me. Leave that list open until this window closes automatically.
progress.retrieve_tunein: Listening for TuneIn favorites from: {sources}. Now open the Control4 app, choose Listen, open each named TuneIn source, then go directly to Favorites. Leave that list open until this window closes automatically.

error.invalid_tidal_playlists: Use: source name | playlist name | UUID, with a valid UUID and no duplicate names per source
error.invalid_tunein_favorites: Use: source name | favorite name | Station/id, with a valid station ID and no duplicate names per source

abort.no_tidal_sources: No inventory-backed TIDAL source is available in a Control4 room.
abort.no_tunein_sources: No inventory-backed TuneIn source is available in a Control4 room.
abort.media_capture_cancelled: Media retrieval was cancelled before it completed.
abort.media_capture_disconnected: The live Control4 connection is unavailable. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.media_capture_timeout: No matching list was received. Try again and leave the requested playlist or favorites screen open in the Control4 app.
abort.media_capture_failed: The media list could not be retrieved from Control4.
abort.stored_media_favorites_invalid: The existing manual media-favorites text is invalid. Correct it under Media favorites, then retrieve again.
abort.entity_ids_already_current: All Control4 entity IDs already use Home Assistant's current automatic naming format.
abort.entity_ids_recreated: Recreated {count} Control4 entity IDs. Update any dashboard, automation, script, or scene references that used the old IDs.
